facts.fact: The Digital Health Act, No. 15 of 2023, commenced 2 November 2023, establishes the state Digital Health Agency and charges it under section 6(d) with establishing a system of shareable and portable personal health records, listing shared health records among the components of the comprehensive integrated health information system it administers; section 48 lists National Assembly appropriations, service fees and grants as the Agency's funds.
facts.system: shared health records (shareable and portable personal health records)
